findings.location: Article, paragraph beginning “Let’s chat a little”
findings.source_quote: “Her mom had left years ago to work in another country, leaving the girls with their Grandma.”
findings.suggested_fix: Use a kinship term that does not specify which side of the family, such as “deras farmor eller mormor,” unless the maternal relationship is known.
findings.translation_quote: “Hennes mamma hade åkt till ett annat land för att arbeta flera år tidigare och lämnat flickorna hos deras mormor.”

findings.source_quote: “His grandma came over several days later, offended”
findings.suggested_fix: Use “hans farmor eller mormor” unless the maternal relationship is known.
findings.translation_quote: “Hans mormor kom över flera dagar senare, tog illa upp”
